document: Privacy Policy
Effective from 2026-10-20. Document version: privacy-2026-10-20.
1. Data Controller
The data controller is Antanas Varnas ("checkauto.lt"). For privacy questions, you can contact us by email at info@checkauto.lt or by phone at +370 609 45 238.
2. Scope of This Policy

This privacy policy applies to the checkauto.lt website, booking form, inquiries, email and phone communication, used-car pre-purchase inspections, computer diagnostics, consulting, invoices, payments and related administrative actions.
Services may be provided to natural persons and companies. Where the client is a company, data of that company's employees, representatives or contact persons may be processed.
3. What Data We May Process
Depending on your use of the website and services, the following data may be processed:
<ul>
• selected service, preliminary or confirmed visit time;
• name, surname, phone number, email address, selected communication language;
• vehicle make, model, year, engine and other vehicle information you provide;
• vehicle location or address, seller or inspection-location information, if you provide it;
• listing URL, additional message, inspection-relevant circumstances and seller information if you forward it;
• booking status, booking number, confirmation, rejection, cancellation, completion, expiry and communication times;
• records of acceptance of the Terms and Conditions and acknowledgement of the Privacy Policy, including document versions and time;
• separate request to begin service within the 14-day withdrawal period and the associated acknowledgment, if provided, including their content and time;
• confirmation that the vehicle will be accessible and that the seller, owner or lawful possessor will allow the inspection;
• optional marketing consent, its text, version, grant, withdrawal or opt-out time;
• email delivery events, for example whether a booking email was sent, failed to send or was technically rejected;
• invoice, payment, service description, VAT status, client details and accounting administration data where an invoice is issued;
• technical security and abuse-prevention data: IP address, pseudonymized or hashed values related to email or phone number, request rate-limit records;
• customer and service administration data;
• technical website operation data where needed for the website, booking process, security, language selection or form protection;
4. Purposes and Legal Bases of Processing
4.1. Receiving a Booking and Entering Into a Service

Data is used to receive the inquiry, check the selected time, temporarily reserve the time, contact you, confirm the visit or suggest an alternative. Legal basis: steps taken prior to entering into a contract and entering into a contract.
4.2. Planning and Performing the Service

Data is used to plan the inspection, arrive at the vehicle location, perform a visual inspection, computer diagnostics, consultation, and provide oral or practical recommendations, photos or other agreed information. Legal basis: performance of a contract.
4.3. Invoices, Payments and Accounting
Data is used to issue invoices, administer payments, accounting, tax obligations and document retention. Legal basis: legal obligation.
4.4. Security, Abuse Prevention and Disputes

Data is used to protect the website and booking system, limit repeated or abusive requests, resolve disputes, keep evidence, ensure service quality and internal administration. Legal basis: legitimate interest.
4.5. Marketing
Newsletters, tips, reminders or offers by email are sent only where you have given separate optional consent. Legal basis: consent. You can withdraw consent at any time.
5. Do You Have to Provide Data?

Some data is necessary so that we can receive a booking, contact you, plan the inspection, arrive at the vehicle location, provide the service, administer payment or issue an invoice, if applicable. If you do not provide your name, contacts, vehicle information, inspection location or other information necessary for the service, the booking may not be confirmed or the service may not be provided.
Marketing consent is not mandatory. Not giving it or withdrawing it does not affect your ability to order a service.
6. Who We May Disclose Data To
Data is disclosed only to the extent needed to provide the service, maintain the website and systems, communicate, handle accounting, ensure security or comply with legal obligations.
<ul>
• Supabase - database, booking API, server-side functions, file storage and system infrastructure. Region used: West EU / Ireland.
• Resend - sending emails to clients and the administrator.
• GitHub Pages - website hosting. Visitors' IP addresses are logged and stored for security purposes. GitHub Privacy Statement.
• iCloud Mail - email services and communication.
• Accounting, legal, IT, security or other service providers where needed for invoices, legal requirements, system operation or dispute resolution.
• State authorities, courts, bailiffs, supervisory authorities or other entities where required by law or by a mandatory lawful request.
7. International Data Transfers

Some supplier infrastructure, subcontractors or technical services may be located outside the European Economic Area. Where such transfer applies, legally required safeguards are used, such as standard contractual clauses or other lawful transfer mechanisms. You can obtain information about the applicable transfer safeguards and a copy by emailing info@checkauto.lt.
8. Cookies and Browser Storage

We use necessary and optional browser storage. The necessary local-storage record checkauto-cookie-consent remembers your acceptance or rejection for 180 days. The session-storage record checkauto-booking-operation helps complete a booking after a connection failure and prevents duplicate submissions; it is removed when the booking is completed or the tab session ends.

The optional record checkauto-lang remembers your selected language only with your consent, for no longer than the consent remains valid. Rejection or withdrawal deletes this record and stops remembering the language for the next page. You can still switch language. You can change your choice at any time using Cookie settings at the bottom of the page. We do not use analytics or advertising trackers.
9. Marketing and Withdrawal of Consent
Marketing messages, news, tips or offers are sent only with separate consent. You can withdraw consent at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link in the email or by writing to info@checkauto.lt.
Withdrawal does not affect lawful processing carried out before withdrawal. Opt-out records may be retained as long as needed to ensure that unwanted marketing messages are not sent to you.
10. Data Retention Periods

We apply the retention practice below. These periods apply according to the usual checkauto.lt data retention practice, unless in a specific case laws, accounting requirements, a dispute, security incident or legal requirements require longer retention.
<ul>
• Booking, service, customer and related administration data - usually 3 years after service completion, cancellation, booking expiry or last communication.
• Service communication - usually 3 years after the last communication, unless there is a dispute or another need to retain it longer.
• Invoices, payment and accounting documents - 10 years or another period set by law.
• Marketing consents - until withdrawal and usually for another 3 years for proof of consent.
• Marketing opt-out records - as long as needed to ensure unwanted messages are not sent.
• Technical security records - about 25 hours, unless needed longer for a security investigation or legal requirements.
• Email delivery events - usually 12 months, unless needed longer for a dispute, technical investigation or legitimate interest.
11. Data Removal and Retention Exceptions
Personal data that is no longer needed is removed in accordance with the applicable retention periods.
Deletion may be limited where data is needed for invoices, accounting, legal obligations, disputes, claims, security incidents or legitimate evidence retention.
12. Your Rights

You have the right to request access to your personal data, rectification, deletion, restriction of processing, data portability, objection to processing where legitimate interest applies, and withdrawal of marketing consent at any time.
Send requests by email to info@checkauto.lt. To protect your data, identity confirmation may be required before fulfilling a request. Requests are answered within the time limits set by law.
13. Data Security

Data is stored in access-restricted systems. Administrative access is limited to authorized persons. Technical and organizational measures are applied to prevent unauthorized access, misuse, accidental loss or unlawful alteration.
14. Complaints and Supervisory Authority
You have the right to lodge a complaint with the State Data Protection Inspectorate (VDAI): vdai.lrv.lt.
15. Changes to This Policy

This policy may be updated if services, suppliers, systems, laws, data processing practice or retention periods change. The latest version is published on this page. If changes materially affect an already confirmed service, they should not be applied retroactively in a way that unreasonably worsens the client's position, unless required by law or clearly agreed.
